name: @red-cup-engineering/activitypub-services-section
description: The Union's canonical public transport: ActivityPub federation carrying CloudEvents whose data is an A2A message with one canonical RMN part.

scripts.check: node --check src/provider.mjs && node --check src/server.mjs && node --check src/onchain.mjs && node --check src/onchain-server.mjs && node --check src/generate-encrypted-evm-wallet.mjs && node --check src/deliver.mjs && node --check src/keys.mjs && node --check src/rmn-activity.mjs && node --check src/rmn-history.mjs && node --check src/rmn-outbox-client.mjs && node --check bin/materialize-rmn-outbox-activity.mjs && node --check test/provider.test.mjs && node --check test/onchain.test.mjs && node --check test/generate-encrypted-evm-wallet.test.mjs && node --check test/rmn-outbox-client.test.mjs && node --check test/rmn-history.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: ActivityPub and ActivityStreams 2.0 objects admitted by Fedify with verified signatures or integrity proofs at inbox boundaries
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: invalid actor, signature, proof, content negotiation, WebFinger identifier, or unauthorized client inbox read

serve-federation.clientInbox: ActivityStreams OrderedCollection and OrderedCollectionPage protected by RFC 6750 Bearer authentication

deliver-activitypub-activity.accepts: customer-authored ActivityStreams Activity on standard input
effects: signed HTTPS POST to one exact recipient inbox

project-rmn-activity.accepts: one standard Activity type, canonical RMN CBOR object, recipient, A2A Agent Card, and optionally one actual A2A ROLE_AGENT message carrying that exact object
project-rmn-activity.returns: one standard ActivityStreams act containing one CloudEvent whose data is an A2A ROLE_AGENT message with one RFC 6920 named application/rmn+cbor part
project-rmn-activity.optionalInnerCarrierRule: preserved only when supplied by the customer inside the admitted A2A message

observe-addressed-rmn-outbox.accepts: one exact ActivityPub outbox, publisher actor, A2A Agent Card, and observing recipient
observe-addressed-rmn-outbox.returns: finite canonical RMN projections that are public or addressed to that recipient

admit-rmn-history.accepts: one authenticated ActivityPub arrival carrying the exact CloudEvents 1.0, A2A, and canonical RMN cone plus its boundary observation time
admit-rmn-history.returns: one content-addressed FederationCarrierAdmissionReceipt and a finite typed FOUR history projection
